source.title: Multiplexed peroxidase-based electron microscopy labeling enables simultaneous visualization of multiple cell types
source.citation: Zhang Q, Lee WCA, Paul DL, Ginty DD. Nature Neuroscience. 2019;22:828–839.

biologicalScope.subtypeResolution: broad inhibitory population; no molecular interneuron subtype assigned to the reconstructed profiles
biologicalScope.interneuronLabelMethod: AAV1-DIO-Matrix-dAPEX2 labels mitochondrial matrix in Slc32a1 IRES-Cre inhibitory neurons
biologicalScope.afferentLabelMethod: AAV9-FDIO-IMS-dAPEX2 labels mitochondrial intermembrane space in Avil FlpO primary somatosensory afferents

publishedReconstruction.profileDescription: one primary-afferent profile plus two inhibitory-interneuron profiles (one axon and one dendrite); profiles are not a cell count
publishedReconstruction.sourceMethod: Images were elastically montaged and aligned in TrakEM2; profiles, mitochondria and synapses were manually reconstructed. TrakEM2 arealists were interpolated and meshes smoothed for the published 3D visualization.

availabilityBoundary.auditScope: primary article text, Figure 4, methods and listed supplementary materials
availabilityBoundary.finding: The source provides a publication-rendered reconstruction and supplementary video. This application links to those source pages but does not contain the raw serial stack, editable area lists, segmentation labels or mesh.

hardBoundaries: This is an independent published spinal-cord example, not the currently selected interneuron or any NeuroMorpho record.
The Slc32a1 label is broad inhibitory-neuron context and does not resolve a named interneuron subtype for these profiles.
The reported axonal and dendritic profiles are not promoted to a stable cell count or a joined complete cell.
Published interpolated and smoothed meshes are viewable only at the linked source; no model geometry is imported, retraced, measured, registered or assigned to a selected record.
The source imagery and supplementary video are opened at the publisher or PMC; media is not copied into this project while file-level reuse terms remain unverified.
A missing or unreachable source page produces no substitute shape and zero project geometry.
